job.description: Test N7: does sharing track how different the readings are, or how hard? Head A predicts the next token; head B predicts the next token (control), 4 or 8 ahead, or the next token with 80% of its targets replaced at random. 5 new seeds, 20 runs, measured on test-split windows 257-512. About 2.3 hours on a T4. Resumable: if a session ends, choose Run all again and finished work is skipped.
